scope: Linux x86_64 GNU AF_PACKET capability and inactive FD preflight only; no bind/send/recv/driver activation

capability_policy.kernel_interface_lookup: Actual libc if_nametoindex; validated <=15B device name, nonzero index, exact input snapshot, /sys/class/net/<iface>/mtu requested 68..65535 <= actual device MTU
capability_policy.protocol: ETH_P_IP=0x0800 required; PACKET_HOST=0 only in preflight and strict metadata classifier (OUTGOING/other packet types refused), nonzero generation
capability_policy.capabilities: Linux capget syscall SYS_CAPGET=125 using Linux capability v3 header/data, effective CAP_NET_RAW bit13 checked before open. Missing bit yields typed PermissionDenied{errno:1}; socket EPERM mapped identically. No UDP fallback.
capability_policy.negative_actual: Test child process removes only its own effective CAP_NET_RAW with Linux capset syscall126, then asserts exact typed EPERM and independently calls real socket(AF_PACKET,SOCK_RAW|SOCK_NONBLOCK|SOCK_CLOEXEC,0) expecting actual errno EPERM=1. Parent runner capabilities unchanged.
capability_policy.raw_fd: Optional protocol=0 AF_PACKET socket (per Linux packet(7) receives no packets) is CLOEXEC/NONBLOCK, held by Rust OwnedFd and dropped exactly once; no bind, send, recv or packet traffic. Positive socket open path conditional on CI capability; no claim that privileged raw FD acquisition occurred.
capability_policy.unprivileged_rollback: Independent native loopback UDP socket used solely in test as transferred kernel-owned FD to prove OwnedFd Drop closes and post-drop fcntl yields EBADF=9 even when CAP_NET_RAW absent; never a substitute/fallback raw transport.
capability_policy.borrow_stop: PacketPreflightFd borrows own OwnedFd under lifetime + BorrowFence.try_enter_ready atomics, generation mismatch fail closed, stop waits for last synchronous loan; cannot create post-stop borrow
capability_policy.rx_metadata: Pure classifier validates ifindex, protocol, packet_type, generation, nontruncated full L3 payload length <=MTU; never declares payload authenticated. No VLAN, full raw device receive or kernel sockaddr_ll parsing.

ffi_audit.source: man7.org packet(7), capget(2); glibc syscall wrapper (capget and capset have no glibc wrappers). No new root dependencies.
ffi_audit.unsafe: Only cfg module #[allow(unsafe_code)] under existing crate-level deny; libc socket/if_nametoindex/fcntl, syscall capget/capset (capset used ONLY in isolated native test child), OwnedFd::from_raw_fd single ownership.
ffi_audit.cap_abi: Linux v3 CapHeader sizeof8 and CapData sizeof12, effective/permitted/inheritable offsets checked actual x86_64 Linux
ffi_audit.no_assumption: No CAP_NET_RAW privilege assumed in GitHub Actions. Positive raw fd open and close test handles typed EPERM as permissible denied host capability, and must not be cited as a positive socket-open proof.

native.direct_artifact_review: Both ZIP artifacts downloaded and SHA-256 verified by independent container; manifest records exact binary SHA/source/compiled-once native x86_64 target; result.json shows 52 test names; test.log actual 52 passed, 0 failed, 7 legacy r0 filtered.
native.qualification: Actual kernel if_nametoindex/sysfs+capset child+permission-negative socket and unprivileged FD close, static packet metadata/generation/loan model. NOT real AF_PACKET traffic exchange or privileged network driver.

historical_runs.context: First code source, 9 new tests and 42 existing; later added a mandatory unconditional unprivileged OwnedFd close test.

historical_runs.cause: ROLE_SCOPE_FAILED: control or source moved mid-audit due concurrent main M0 movement, not a Rust native test failure; no permission expansion or role writer overlap claimed

historical_runs.actual: 59/59 actual Rust assertions passed (7 old R0 plus 52 R1), legacy worker branch R0 harness requires exactly 7; M0-only main fixed root filter on separate SOURCE.

not_run: AF_PACKET bind, recvmsg/recvmmsg/sendmmsg on a real raw FD
Any actual Ethernet/VLAN/packet capture, interface activation or NIC traffic
